subtitles.en: Good to be with you from the White House tonight.
subtitles.zh: 今晚很高兴在白宫与大家见面。

subtitles.en: I’m Tony Dokoupil.
subtitles.zh: 我是托尼·多库皮尔。

subtitles.en: The breaking news right now.
subtitles.zh: 现在插播突发新闻。

subtitles.en: President Trump welcomes China’s Xi Jinping with a military flyover and a lavish state dinner.
subtitles.zh: 特朗普总统以军机飞行表演和盛大国宴欢迎中国国家主席习近平。

subtitles.en: China’s first state visit in more than a decade.
subtitles.zh: 这是中国十多年来首次国事访问。

subtitles.en: But some members of the President’s own party aren’t happy.
subtitles.zh: 但总统本党的一些成员并不高兴。

subtitles.en: When you have world leaders looking at this reception compared to the way President Zelenskyy has been received, you go, like, that’s a WTF moment.
subtitles.zh: 当世界领导人看到这种接待规格，再对比泽连斯基总统受到的待遇，你会觉得，这简直是个“WTF”时刻。

subtitles.en: Also breaking tonight, the monster storm set to slam the East Coast.
subtitles.zh: 今晚还有突发消息，一场怪兽级风暴即将袭击东海岸。

subtitles.en: A powerful nor’easter.
subtitles.zh: 一场强大的东北风暴。

subtitles.en: Winds up to 60 miles an hour.
subtitles.zh: 风速最高可达每小时60英里。

subtitles.en: Heavy rain and flooding, as well.
subtitles.zh: 还会有暴雨和洪水。

subtitles.en: Rob Marciano in the storm zone.
subtitles.zh: 罗布·马尔恰诺在风暴现场。

subtitles.en: And why Stanford University is apologizing for a photo on a campus banner.
subtitles.zh: 以及斯坦福大学为何为一幅校园横幅上的照片道歉。

subtitles.en: What it shows and the backlash tonight.
subtitles.zh: 照片显示了什么，以及今晚引发的强烈反对。

subtitles.en: High-speed chase.
subtitles.zh: 高速追车。

subtitles.en: A carjacking suspect races through streets near Miami evading police multiple times speeding in reverse.
subtitles.zh: 一名劫车嫌疑人驾车在迈阿密附近的街道上飞驰，多次躲避警方，还挂倒挡加速。

subtitles.en: How it ended.
subtitles.zh: 最终如何收场。

subtitles.en: CBS News exclusive.
subtitles.zh: CBS新闻独家报道。

subtitles.en: A sneak peek of Taylor Swift’s new video for the song "Patient Zero" before it drops at midnight.
subtitles.zh: 泰勒·斯威夫特为歌曲《零号病人》拍摄的新MV在午夜上线前抢先看。

subtitles.en: And panda diplomacy is back.
subtitles.zh: 熊猫外交回来了。

subtitles.en: Tonight, China’s new gift to America.
subtitles.zh: 今晚，中国送给美国的新礼物。

subtitles.en: This is the "CBS Evening News" with Tony Dokoupil, reporting tonight from the White House.
subtitles.zh: 这是《CBS晚间新闻》，由托尼·多库皮尔在白宫为您报道。

subtitles.en: And good evening.
subtitles.zh: 晚上好。

subtitles.en: Great to have you with us on a historic Thursday night in Washington, D.C. you’ve got a view of the North Portico of the White House behind me.
subtitles.zh: 很高兴在这个历史性的周四晚上与大家相聚在华盛顿特区。你看到我身后就是白宫的北门廊。

subtitles.en: That is the entry point for tonight’s state dinner in the East Room, after what has already been a day of major events.
subtitles.zh: 那是今晚东厅国宴的入口，而此前这一天已经发生了多项重大活动。

subtitles.en: President Trump welcoming Chinese President Xi Jinping to the White House, his first visit to Washington in more than a decade, a moment marked by flyovers of both U.S. fighter jets and a B-2 stealth bomber.
subtitles.zh: 特朗普总统在白宫欢迎中国国家主席习近平，这是他十多年来首次访问华盛顿，现场有美国战斗机和B-2隐形轰炸机飞过。

subtitles.en: Inside, President Trump hailing what he called a truly great friendship, while Xi, through a translator, told Trump "I am ready to work with you."
subtitles.zh: 在白宫内部，特朗普总统称赞他所说的“真正伟大的友谊”，而习近平通过翻译告诉特朗普：“我准备好与你合作。”

subtitles.en: And our Weijia Jiang is here with me with more on that part of the story.
subtitles.zh: 本台记者江伟佳就在我身边，她会带来更多相关报道。

subtitles.en: Weijia, good evening.
subtitles.zh: 伟佳，晚上好。

subtitles.en: Tony, it’s great to have you here in Washington where that very delicate dance between the world’s superpowers is on full display.
subtitles.zh: 托尼，很高兴你来到华盛顿，在这里，世界两个超级大国之间那场非常微妙的周旋正全面上演。

subtitles.en: Presidents Trump and Xi Jinping are balancing their warm relationship with the fierce competition between the U.S. and China.
subtitles.zh: 特朗普和习近平两位总统正在平衡他们之间的热络关系与中美之间的激烈竞争。

subtitles.en: President Trump hosted his Chinese counterpart, Xi Jinping for formal talks at the White House, praising a, quote truly great friendship.
subtitles.zh: 特朗普总统在白宫为他的中国同行习近平举行了正式会谈，称赞了一段“真正伟大的友谊”。

subtitles.en: But they are grappling with several thorny issues: Iran, Taiwan, trade, and the intense AI arms race.
subtitles.zh: 但他们正面临几个棘手问题：伊朗、台湾、贸易，以及激烈的人工智能军备竞赛。

subtitles.en: AI leaders are urging the U.S. and China to implement global guidelines.
subtitles.zh: 人工智能领域的领袖们正敦促美中两国实施全球准则。

subtitles.en: Trump recently said "I want to leave it exactly where it is."
subtitles.zh: 特朗普最近说：“我想让它就保持原样。”

subtitles.en: We don’t want to restrict them where all of a sudden we come in second to China.
subtitles.zh: 我们不想限制它们，结果一下子被中国反超、变成第二。

subtitles.en: Xi said both the U.S. and China have the capability and responsibility to develop and manage AI for good.
subtitles.zh: 习近平说，美中双方都有能力和责任开发和运用人工智能，让它造福人类。

subtitles.en: Trump put on a show for the Chinese leader, with a tour of Marine One, a flyover, and a performance by a military band.
subtitles.zh: 特朗普为这位中国领导人安排了一场展示：参观“海军陆战队一号”、飞行表演，还有军乐队演出。

subtitles.en: Back in 2012, private citizen Trump criticized then-president Obama for doing similar, calling it "so wrong" to give Xi a full honor ceremony.
subtitles.zh: 早在2012年，还是普通公民的特朗普曾批评时任总统奥巴马做过类似的事，称给习近平举行全套荣誉仪式“非常错误”。

subtitles.en: The high-profile visit comes as the administration faces a court fight over press access.
subtitles.zh: 这次高调访问正值美国政府因新闻采访权限面临法庭之争。

subtitles.en: Today, a federal judge ordered the White House to immediately reinstate press credentials for CNN, MS NOW, and "Politico," after Trump banned them over what he called negative coverage.
subtitles.zh: 今天，一名联邦法官命令白宫立即恢复CNN、MSNBC和《政客》的记者证，此前特朗普以所谓负面报道为由禁止他们进入。

subtitles.en: But the case is not closed.
subtitles.zh: 但案件还没有结束。

subtitles.en: This is not a final ruling on the merits.
subtitles.zh: 这不是对案件实质的最终裁决。

subtitles.en: This does not mean that CNN and MS NOW and "Politico" won.
subtitles.zh: 这并不意味着CNN、MSNBC和《政客》赢了。

subtitles.en: Even though journalists from those outlets are back on White House grounds for now, the administration has not restored CNN as part of the press pool that provides TV coverage of the President, and until that happens, the other networks will not participate which is why we didn’t have footage today, Tony, of all of those events.
subtitles.zh: 尽管这些媒体的记者目前已经回到白宫场地，但政府还没有恢复CNN作为提供总统电视报道的记者团成员；在那之前，其他电视网也不会参与，所以托尼，我们今天没有那些活动的画面。

subtitles.en: Yeah, a big gap there.
subtitles.zh: 是啊，这一块缺失很大。

subtitles.en: Speaking of TV, there is a new pro-Trump ad airing on cable and broadcast that apparently has tax dollars mixed up in it.
subtitles.zh: 说到电视，现在有一则支持特朗普的新广告在有线和广播电视上播出，里面似乎混入了纳税人的钱。

subtitles.en: What do we know?
subtitles.zh: 我们了解到了什么？

subtitles.en: That’s right, so this ad features the President talking about defeating communism, and it’s mostly, you know, a promotion of his achievements, but it’s the words "paid for by the U.S. government" that is drawing fire because some Democrats say the ad violates federal ethics rules that prohibit the use of government resources for campaign purposes.
subtitles.zh: 没错，这则广告主打总统谈论击败共产主义，而且主要是宣传他的政绩，但引起争议的是“由美国政府付费”这几个字，因为一些民主党人说这则广告违反了禁止将政府资源用于竞选目的的联邦伦理规则。

subtitles.en: But the White House says it’s quote, clearly not political and a similar ad will air on this network tonight, Tony.
subtitles.zh: 但白宫说它“显然不是政治性的”，而且一则类似的广告今晚也将在本电视网播出，托尼。

subtitles.en: Weijia, thank you very much, it is great to be here with you in Washington.
subtitles.zh: 伟佳，非常感谢你，很高兴和你在华盛顿一起。

subtitles.en: And earlier on Capitol Hill, I spoke with Senator Thom Tillis of North Carolina, one of the Republicans trying to make sense of the President’s shift toward China between his first and his second terms.
subtitles.zh: 早些时候在国会山，我采访了北卡罗来纳州参议员汤姆·蒂利斯，他是试图理解总统在第一和第二任期之间对华态度转变的共和党人之一。

subtitles.en: He says he just can’t figure it out.
subtitles.zh: 他说他就是想不明白。

subtitles.en: How do you feel about the state visit and the state dinner tonight?
subtitles.zh: 你如何看待今晚的国事访问和国宴？

subtitles.en: Do you agree with the timing?
subtitles.zh: 你觉得这个时间点合适吗？

subtitles.en: I actually think it’s bad timing.
subtitles.zh: 我其实觉得时机不好。

subtitles.en: I mean, we are at a time where President Trump, who I support a majority of the time, you know ran on a campaign of holding China accountable.
subtitles.zh: 我的意思是，我们正处在这样一个时期：我大多数时候支持的特朗普总统，你知道，他当初竞选时说的是要让中国承担责任。

subtitles.en: I’m worried about the trend of spending more time with despots and less time with Democratic leaders of nations.
subtitles.zh: 我担心这种趋势：花更多时间和独裁者在一起，而花更少时间与民主国家的领导人相处。

subtitles.en: So you agree the President has taken a softer approach toward China in his second term?
subtitles.zh: 所以你认为总统在第二任期对中国的态度变软了？

subtitles.en: Look, I mean, this President in a speech in this term took on the Chinese for degrading and stealing voter data.
subtitles.zh: 听着，我的意思是，这位总统本任期在一次演讲中抨击了中国贬低和窃取选民数据的行为。

subtitles.en: Whatever has changed had to have been at a confidential level because I haven’t seen any public basis for the sea change that we see right now in our posture towards China.
subtitles.zh: 不管发生了什么变化，肯定都是在保密层面进行的，因为我没有看到任何公开依据，能解释我们现在对华姿态出现的这种巨大转变。

subtitles.en: You’ve got to have a relationship with them, I get that.
subtitles.zh: 你得跟他们保持关系，这点我理解。

subtitles.en: But when you have world leaders looking at this reception compared to the way, maybe President Zelenskyy has been received, you go, like, it’s a WTF moment.
subtitles.zh: 但当世界各国领导人看到这种接待规格，再对比泽连斯基总统受到的待遇时，你会觉得，这真是个让人直呼“什么鬼”的时刻。

subtitles.en: Tillis is leaving Congress in January after a series of differences with President Trump, and he is one of four Republican senators who just yesterday called on the Trump administration to deliver on a stalled $14 billion arms deal for Taiwan -- a deal of course, that China opposes.
subtitles.zh: 蒂利斯因与特朗普总统存在一系列分歧，将于一月离开国会。他是昨天呼吁特朗普政府履行那份被搁置的、价值140亿美元对台军售协议的四名共和党参议员之一——这项协议当然遭到中国反对。

subtitles.en: Meanwhile, back in New York at the U.N. General Assembly today Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu mounted a campaign-style defense of Israel’s battles in the Middle East -- and took on New York’s Mayor in the process.
subtitles.zh: 与此同时，回到纽约联合国大会现场，以色列总理内塔尼亚胡今天为以色列在中东的军事行动进行了一场竞选式辩护，并在此过程中抨击了纽约市长。

subtitles.en: He called accusations of genocide in Gaza, quote, the biggest lie of the century.
subtitles.zh: 他称有关加沙种族灭绝的指控是“本世纪最大的谎言”。

subtitles.en: He labeled the dozens of delegates who walked out before he even began to speak moral cowards.
subtitles.zh: 他把那些在他还没开始讲话就离场的几十名代表称为道德懦夫。

subtitles.en: And he accused Mayor Mamdani who has repeatedly said Netanyahu should be arrested over alleged war crimes, of trying to silence him.
subtitles.zh: 他还指责马姆达尼市长试图让他闭嘴；后者曾多次表示，内塔尼亚胡应因涉嫌战争罪被逮捕。

subtitles.en: Netanyahu also had a message for the leaders of Iran as that war drags on.
subtitles.zh: 随着那场战争持续拖延，内塔尼亚胡还向伊朗领导人发出了一个信息。

subtitles.en: One day, and it may not be far away, the Iranian people will be free.
subtitles.zh: 总有一天，而且可能不会太远，伊朗人民将获得自由。

subtitles.en: Their murderous regime will be toppled by its lies, by its corruption, by its cruelty.
subtitles.zh: 那个残暴的政权将被它自己的谎言、腐败和暴虐所推翻。

subtitles.en: Outside the speech dozens of antiwar protesters blocked a road and were arrested, among them the actor Susan Sarandon.
subtitles.zh: 演讲会场外，数十名反战抗议者堵塞了一条道路并被逮捕，其中包括演员苏珊·萨兰登。

subtitles.en: And we turn now to weather and the powerful nor’easter bearing down on the Atlantic Coast.
subtitles.zh: 我们现在转向天气，一股强大的东北风暴正在逼近大西洋海岸。

subtitles.en: Warnings of high surf, strong winds and heavy rain are posted for hundreds of miles.
subtitles.zh: 数百英里范围内已发布巨浪、强风和大雨警报。

subtitles.en: Our Tom Hanson has it all covered tonight from Massachusetts.
subtitles.zh: 本台记者汤姆·汉森今晚在马萨诸塞州带来全面报道。

subtitles.en: This powerful nor’easter punished several states today.
subtitles.zh: 这场强大的东北风暴今天重创了多个州。

subtitles.en: Starting with North Carolina’s Outer Banks.
subtitles.zh: 首当其冲的是北卡罗来纳州的外滩群岛。

subtitles.en: Surging water washed out the main highway connecting these popular barrier islands.
subtitles.zh: 汹涌的海水冲毁了连接这些热门障壁岛的主要公路。

subtitles.en: The pounding surf quickly consumed streets and surrounded homes, with waves topping 16 feet and wind gusts of more than 45 miles per hour.
subtitles.zh: 猛烈拍岸的海浪迅速吞没街道、包围房屋，浪高超过16英尺，阵风时速超过45英里。

subtitles.en: In Virginia, the high winds pushed massive amounts of water into its low-lying tidal basin flooding communities in the Norfolk area.
subtitles.zh: 在弗吉尼亚州，强风将大量海水推入低洼的潮汐盆地，淹没了诺福克地区的社区。

subtitles.en: It’s very scary.
subtitles.zh: 这非常可怕。

subtitles.en: This area can really be, it can be devastating.
subtitles.zh: 这个地区的情况真的可能变得很严重，可能极具破坏性。

subtitles.en: Parts of New Jersey’s coastline are already showing signs of beach erosion, a major concern in these potent storms.
subtitles.zh: 新泽西州部分海岸线已经出现海滩侵蚀迹象，这在强风暴中是一大隐患。

subtitles.en: In the coastal town of Sea Bright, locals were on high alert.
subtitles.zh: 在沿海小镇锡布赖特，当地居民高度戒备。

subtitles.en: So we are, like, preparing for it to flood pretty bad.
subtitles.zh: 所以我们算是正在为可能相当严重的洪水做准备。

subtitles.en: Meanwhile meanwhile Hurricane Polo, one of the strongest storms ever in the Pacific, regained strength off Mexico’s southwestern coast sending heavy bands of rain and huge waves crashing ashore.
subtitles.zh: 与此同时，飓风波洛——太平洋有史以来最强风暴之一——在墨西哥西南海岸附近重新增强，给沿海带来强降雨带和巨浪冲击。

subtitles.en: As weather-weary residents in southern California hoped for the best.
subtitles.zh: 南加州那些早已对恶劣天气疲惫不堪的居民则希望一切顺利。

subtitles.en: Hurricane Marie left us with a lot less sand than we started with, and so our guys are just shoring up our defenses.
subtitles.zh: 飓风玛丽让我们这里的沙子比原来少了很多，所以我们的工作人员正在加固防御设施。

subtitles.en: While mainland North America is seeing the impacts from these two separate storms, hundreds of miles away Hawaii residents brace for Tropical Storm Nolo, expected to gain Hurricane strength bringing as much as 35 inches of rainfall to the same areas battered by Hurricane Lala.
subtitles.zh: 在北美大陆正遭受这两场各自风暴影响的同时，数百英里外的夏威夷居民正在防备热带风暴诺洛。预计它将增强为飓风，给曾遭飓风拉拉重创的同一地区带来多达35英寸的降雨。

subtitles.en: It can get very serious very fast.
subtitles.zh: 形势可能很快变得非常严峻。

subtitles.en: And Tony, take a look behind me, you can see the waves are rolling in.
subtitles.zh: 托尼，看看我身后，你可以看到海浪正滚滚而来。

subtitles.en: That is only going to intensify as we head into the weekend.
subtitles.zh: 随着进入周末，这种情况只会进一步加剧。

subtitles.en: Now, at the height of the storm waves could reach up to 25 feet Tony.
subtitles.zh: 而在风暴最猛烈时，浪高可能达到25英尺，托尼。

subtitles.en: All right, Tom thank you very much.
subtitles.zh: 好的，汤姆，非常感谢。

subtitles.en: On that note, let’s get the forecast now from meteorologist Rob Marciano.
subtitles.zh: 接下来，我们请气象学家罗布·马尔恰诺带来天气预报。

subtitles.en: He is tracking the nor’easter as well as a swarm of hurricanes out there in the Pacific.
subtitles.zh: 他正在追踪东北风暴以及太平洋上的一连串飓风。

subtitles.en: Rob, good evening.
subtitles.zh: 罗布，晚上好。

subtitles.en: Hey, Tony.
subtitles.zh: 嗨，托尼。

subtitles.en: Yeah, lots to get to, so let’s get to what’s happening here in the Northeast.
subtitles.zh: 是的，有很多内容要说，我们先来看东北部正在发生什么。

subtitles.en: The coastal advisories.
subtitles.zh: 先看沿海预警。

subtitles.en: The high wind warning now that was just posted for Eastern New England, including Boston and Providence, and the major flooding that’s possible across the coastlines there.
subtitles.zh: 新英格兰东部刚刚发布了强风警报，包括波士顿和普罗维登斯，沿海地区可能出现严重洪水。

subtitles.en: Beach erosion, we mentioned that.
subtitles.zh: 海滩侵蚀，我们刚才提到过。

subtitles.en: And the winds could be over 60 miles per hour and the big waves.
subtitles.zh: 风速可能超过每小时60英里，还会有大浪。

subtitles.en: So let’s go with one of our computer models, the most reliable one shows a low just off the coast of the Carolinas and then it drifts slowly off towards the north and maybe towards the west, closer to the Jersey Shore, so that’s when we will start to get impacts in New Jersey, New York, and then Connecticut, as well, and then kind of filling out and drifting Northeast on Sunday, and weakening as it does so, but it will be a high impact weekend for sure, with rainfall.
subtitles.zh: 我们来看一个计算机模型。最可靠的模型显示，一个低压系统就在卡罗来纳海岸附近，随后会缓慢向北漂移，可能还会向西靠近泽西海岸。到那时，新泽西、纽约以及康涅狄格州都会开始受到影响。周日，它会向东北方向漂移并逐渐减弱。但可以肯定，这个周末会带来很大影响，还有降雨。

subtitles.en: Into the Pacific we go.
subtitles.zh: 我们再来看太平洋。

subtitles.en: Polo still a major Hurricane expected to make landfall in the Baja as a cat 2, but Nolo is of more immediate concern.
subtitles.zh: 飓风波洛仍是强飓风，预计将以2级强度在下加利福尼亚登陆；但热带风暴诺洛更令人担忧。

subtitles.en: About 300 miles south of the Big Island of Hawaii, likely to make an approach there as a major storm, and like Lala did just about a month ago, so big time rains there as they still recover from that storm.
subtitles.zh: 它目前位于夏威夷大岛以南约300英里，可能以强风暴级别逼近那里。就像大约一个月前飓风拉拉那样，当地仍在从上一场风暴中恢复，届时将迎来强降雨。

subtitles.en: So high anxiety in Hawaii and the Northeast over the next couple of days.
subtitles.zh: 所以接下来几天，夏威夷和东北部都将高度紧张。

subtitles.en: Tony?
subtitles.zh: 托尼？

subtitles.en: All right, Rob thank you very much.
subtitles.zh: 好的，罗布，非常感谢。

subtitles.en: In other news, into Pittsburgh now, the story of a prominent doctor stabbed to death in his own home, attacked in the middle of the night while he and his wife were sleeping.
subtitles.zh: 其他新闻方面，现在来看匹兹堡。一位知名医生在自己家中被刺身亡，他是在深夜和妻子睡觉时遭到袭击的。

subtitles.en: The details now from CBS’s Meg Oliver.
subtitles.zh: 详细报道来自CBS的梅格·奥利弗。

subtitles.en: Multiple people stabbed.
subtitles.zh: 有多人被刺伤。

subtitles.en: A horrible scene unfolded shortly after midnight.
subtitles.zh: 午夜过后不久，一个可怕的场景出现了。

subtitles.en: Police say 32-year-old Elijah Hemingway broke into the home of Dr.
subtitles.zh: 警方称，32岁的伊莱贾·海明威闯入了医生

subtitles.en: Idris Evans and his home of Dr.
subtitles.zh: 伊德里斯·埃文斯博士的家中

subtitles.en: Idris Evans and his wife near Pittsburgh and stabbed the pair multiple times while they were sleeping.
subtitles.zh: 伊德里斯·埃文斯和妻子住在匹兹堡附近，他趁两人睡觉时多次刺伤他们。

subtitles.en: It was a very violent scene.
subtitles.zh: 现场非常暴力。

subtitles.en: The bedroom furniture broken mirrors broken.
subtitles.zh: 卧室家具被砸坏，镜子也碎了。

subtitles.en: It was a very, it was a very graphic scene.
subtitles.zh: 那是一个，那是一个非常触目惊心的现场。

subtitles.en: Police say Evans’ wife managed to escape and ran from their home with their two young children.
subtitles.zh: 警方说，埃文斯的妻子设法逃脱，带着两个年幼的孩子从家里跑了出来。

subtitles.en: The couple was taken to the hospital in critical condition but Evans later died.
subtitles.zh: 夫妻两人被送医时情况危急，但埃文斯后来不治身亡。

subtitles.en: We do not know if there was any preexisting relationship.
subtitles.zh: 我们尚不清楚双方之前是否认识。

subtitles.en: The woman did not know this male.
subtitles.zh: 这名女子不认识这名男子。

subtitles.en: We are trying to determine if the two males knew each other.
subtitles.zh: 我们正在努力确认这两名男子是否彼此认识。

subtitles.en: According to the police report, his wife said the suspect was in his underwear and remembers her husband addressing the attacker as "Elijah."
subtitles.zh: 根据警方报告，他的妻子说嫌疑人当时只穿着内裤，并记得她丈夫称袭击者为“以利亚”。

subtitles.en: However, she said she did not know the man.
subtitles.zh: 然而，她说她不认识这名男子。

subtitles.en: Investigators say the suspect was found hiding behind a nearby home.
subtitles.zh: 调查人员说，嫌疑人被发现藏在附近一栋房子后面。

subtitles.en: He was hiding.
subtitles.zh: 他当时藏在那里。

subtitles.en: There was an area of my garden it’s not particularly well manicured like the other parts and he had found a way to conceal himself, but apparently he was injured and bleeding.
subtitles.zh: 我花园里有一块地方不像其他地方打理得那么好，他找到了办法把自己藏起来，但显然他受了伤并且在流血。

subtitles.en: Police say there is no motive at this time, but that Hemingway has an extensive criminal background.
subtitles.zh: 警方说目前还没有发现作案动机，但海明威有大量犯罪前科。

subtitles.en: He now faces multiple charges including homicide.
subtitles.zh: 他现在面临多项指控，包括杀人罪。

subtitles.en: Tony?
subtitles.zh: 托尼？

subtitles.en: Meg, thank you.
subtitles.zh: 梅格，谢谢。

subtitles.en: Stanford University is apologizing tonight for what it calls a serious error in judgment, editing a photo of students to alter looks, race and gender.
subtitles.zh: 斯坦福大学今晚为其所称的“严重判断失误”致歉，他们编辑了一张学生照片，改变了外貌、种族和性别。

subtitles.en: And as our Jonathan Vigliotti reports, one of the students was transformed beyond recognition.
subtitles.zh: 据我们的乔纳森·维格利奥蒂报道，其中一名学生被改得面目全非。

subtitles.en: A Stanford University photographer took this picture to promote the student dining services.
subtitles.zh: 斯坦福大学的一名摄影师拍了这张照片，用于宣传学生餐饮服务。

subtitles.en: Races.
subtitles.zh: 种族。

subtitles.en: Because last week, Stanford used AI to change the image to this.
subtitles.zh: 因为上周，斯坦福大学使用人工智能把这张图片改成了这样。

subtitles.en: When compared side by side, the Latino man became a black woman.
subtitles.zh: 两图对比之下，原本的拉丁裔男子被变成了黑人女性。

subtitles.en: The other two faces were altered.
subtitles.zh: 另外两张脸也被改动过。

subtitles.en: The student who disappeared from the photo, Billy Ramirez, told "the Stanford Daily," "seeing my identity changed and being left out of the picture made me feel in a way, silenced and erased."
subtitles.zh: 从照片中消失的学生比利·拉米雷斯告诉《斯坦福日报》：“看到我的身份被改变，还被从照片中抹掉，这让我在某种程度上感到被噤声、被抹去。”

subtitles.en: The other two students posted a letter to the Stanford community on Substack demanding a public apology and writing, "using AI to create so-called diversity rather than showing true Stanford diversity, is a clear sign of the administration slapping a band-aid on a greater DEI problem."
subtitles.zh: 另外两名学生在 Substack 上向斯坦福社区发了一封公开信，要求校方公开道歉，并写道：“利用人工智能制造所谓的多元性，而不是展现斯坦福真实的多元性，这清楚表明校方只是在一个更大的 DEI 问题上贴创可贴。”

subtitles.en: Stanford University figures show that in recent years, black and Latino enrollment have sharply declined since the Supreme Court’s 2023 ruling banning race-based admissions.
subtitles.zh: 斯坦福大学的数据显示，近年来，自从最高法院2023年裁定禁止基于种族的招生以来，黑人和拉丁裔学生的入学人数急剧下降。

subtitles.en: Today, Stanford said the photo manipulation was in violation of University policy.
subtitles.zh: 今天，斯坦福大学表示，修改照片的行为违反了学校政策。

subtitles.en: Both the alteration and lack of disclosure in this case violate that policy.
subtitles.zh: 本案中的修改行为以及未披露相关信息都违反了该政策。

subtitles.en: And that photo was part of a banner welcoming students back to campus.
subtitles.zh: 那张照片是欢迎学生返校横幅的一部分。

subtitles.en: It has since been taken down but it’s still unclear, Tony why it was doctored in the first place.
subtitles.zh: 该横幅后来被撤下，但托尼，目前仍不清楚当初为什么要篡改照片。

subtitles.en: Jonathan, thank you very much.
subtitles.zh: 乔纳森，非常感谢。

subtitles.en: We also have more tonight on the death of those two Mississippi college students and the possible link to a widely-available drug.
subtitles.zh: 今晚我们还有更多关于那两名密西西比大学生死亡事件的报道，以及可能与一种随处可得的药物有关。

subtitles.en: Our Lilia Luciano now with what we are learning and the new warning from authorities.
subtitles.zh: 我们的莉莉亚·卢西亚诺现在带来我们了解到的信息和官方发布的新警告。

subtitles.en: Possible OD, they do not believe the subject is breathing.
subtitles.zh: 可能是用药过量，急救人员认为当事人已没有呼吸。

subtitles.en: State authorities are working to expedite toxicology reports for two University of Mississippi students who were found dead on Monday in separate incidents.
subtitles.zh: 州当局正在加快出具两名密西西比大学学生的毒理学报告，这两名学生周一分别在不同事件中被发现死亡。

subtitles.en: We are not even sure that both of them were overdose.
subtitles.zh: 我们甚至不确定两人是否都是死于用药过量。

subtitles.en: Investigators say there is no evidence the deaths are connected, but acknowledged that similarly-packaged kratom a popular supplement that can produce an opioid-like effect was found at both scenes.
subtitles.zh: 调查人员说，目前没有证据表明这两起死亡事件有关联，但他们承认，在两个现场都发现了包装相似的卡痛——这是一种流行的补充剂，能产生类似阿片类药物的效果。

subtitles.en: In what form was the kratom?
subtitles.zh: 卡痛是以什么形式出现的？

subtitles.en: It appears it is very similar.
subtitles.zh: 看起来非常相似。

subtitles.en: We are concerned it is coming from a common source and if it did result in the death of these two young individuals, we will want to make sure they are identified at the source.
subtitles.zh: 我们担心它们来自同一个来源；如果它确实导致这两名年轻人死亡，我们希望确保能从源头上查清来源。

subtitles.en: Today, the University of Mississippi identified the two students as 18-year-old Aidan Hamilton a freshman from Englewood Colorado, found unresponsive in a dorm and 20-year-old Robert Strang, a junior from Atlanta, who authorities say was found in an off-campus apartment.
subtitles.zh: 今天，密西西比大学确认这两名学生分别是：18岁的艾丹·汉密尔顿，来自科罗拉多州恩格尔伍德的大一新生，在宿舍里被发现时已无反应；以及20岁的罗伯特·斯特朗，来自亚特兰大的大三学生，当局称他在校外公寓被发现。

subtitles.en: A spokesperson for the Strang family said in a statement that they are trying to process this unimaginable loss.
subtitles.zh: 斯特朗家的一名发言人在声明中说，他们正在努力消化这难以想象的丧亲之痛。

subtitles.en: Students on campus expressed grief, shock, and fear over the deaths.
subtitles.zh: 校园里的学生对这两起死亡事件表达了悲痛、震惊和恐惧。

subtitles.en: I think for several students this has made them too upset to go to classes.
subtitles.zh: 我觉得对一些学生来说，这件事让他们太难过了，没法去上课。

subtitles.en: And that toxicology report that could confirm whether any substances played a role in either of the deaths could come out as early as tomorrow.
subtitles.zh: 那份可能确认是否有任何物质在两人死亡中起作用的毒理学报告最早明天就可能出来。

subtitles.en: Tony?
subtitles.zh: 托尼？

subtitles.en: Lilia, thank you very much.
subtitles.zh: 莉莉亚，非常感谢。

subtitles.en: Still ahead on the broadcast tonight, a police chase that started at the hospital and ended at the jail.
subtitles.zh: 今晚节目稍后：一场从医院开始、到监狱结束的警方追捕。

subtitles.en: In Miami-Dade County today, police say a man broke himself out of a hospital carjacked a woman, and then led authorities on a wild chase.
subtitles.zh: 今天在迈阿密-戴德县，警方说一名男子从医院逃出，劫走一名女子的车，然后引发了疯狂追逐。

subtitles.en: Our Cristian Benavides has details.
subtitles.zh: 我们的克里斯蒂安·贝纳维德斯带来详细报道。

subtitles.en: A wild scene playing out in South Florida as the man behind the wheel of this black Nissan led police on a chase through the streets of northwest Miami-Dade County.
subtitles.zh: 南佛罗里达上演了疯狂一幕：驾驶这辆黑色日产汽车的男子在迈阿密-戴德县西北部的街道上带领警方展开追逐。

subtitles.en: Police have tried on several occasions to use P.I.T. maneuvers.
subtitles.zh: 警方曾多次尝试使用 PIT 截停战术。

subtitles.en: Hialeah police say Eugene Jordan Brown sped through several residential neighborhoods as Miami-Dade County sheriff’s deputies and Florida Highway Patrol tried several times unsuccessfully to P.I.T. maneuver the vehicle.
subtitles.zh: 海厄利亚警方说，尤金·乔丹·布朗驾车高速穿过多个居民区，而迈阿密-戴德县警长办公室的警员和佛罗里达州高速公路巡逻队多次尝试用 PIT 截停战术逼停车辆，但都没有成功。

subtitles.en: At one point, Brown puts the vehicle in reverse to evade officers.
subtitles.zh: 有一次，布朗把车挂入倒挡以躲避警察。

subtitles.en: He then speeds away, nearly striking police vehicles and other drivers.
subtitles.zh: 随后他加速逃走，差点撞上警车和其他司机。

subtitles.en: Get him!
subtitles.zh: 抓住他！

subtitles.en: Police say the driver may have been receiving mental health treatment at a local hospital, where the suspect carjacked a woman getting out of her vehicle and forced himself in.
subtitles.zh: 警方说，这名司机可能一直在当地一家医院接受心理健康治疗；在医院，嫌疑人劫持了一名正下车的女子，并强行进入她的车内。

subtitles.en: This may finally be the moment where police have brought this vehicle down.
subtitles.zh: 这可能是警方最终逼停这辆车的时刻。

subtitles.en: After several attempts and about 30 minutes of giving chase, police were finally able to stop the driver.
subtitles.zh: 经过多次尝试和大约30分钟的追逐，警方终于将司机拦下。

subtitles.en: They surrounded the vehicle with guns drawn, pulled the suspect from the window, and took him the chase played out on live television.
subtitles.zh: 他们拔枪包围车辆，把嫌疑人从车窗拉出并带走；这场追逐在电视直播中实时播出。

subtitles.en: Authorities say that the woman who was carjacked had to be taken to the hospital for treatment.
subtitles.zh: 当局说，被劫车的女子不得不被送往医院接受治疗。

subtitles.en: Tony?
subtitles.zh: 托尼？

subtitles.en: Cristian, thank you very much.
subtitles.zh: 克里斯蒂安，非常感谢你。

subtitles.en: After the break, the delivery guy, the rooster, and what happened next.
subtitles.zh: 广告之后，快递员、公鸡，以及接下来发生的事。

subtitles.en: Some Americans on vacation in Alberta, Canada, say they saw a moose, some elk, and this unbelievable landing, a small plane coming in steep and leveling off and touching down safely on the side of a highway there.
subtitles.zh: 在加拿大艾伯塔省度假的一些美国人说，他们看到了驼鹿、麋鹿，还看到了这次不可思议的降落：一架小飞机陡直下降后拉平，安全降落在那边一条公路旁。

subtitles.en: They got the video to prove it.
subtitles.zh: 他们有视频为证。

subtitles.en: That’s a pretty beautiful backdrop there, as well.
subtitles.zh: 那里的背景也相当漂亮。

subtitles.en: And spare a thought for your local delivery people.
subtitles.zh: 也请体谅一下你们当地的快递员。

subtitles.en: [Rooster crowing] ooh-ee!
subtitles.zh: （公鸡打鸣）喔——咿！

subtitles.en: [Rooster crowing] they see it all, and if you are this Amazon guy in South Carolina, that includes a not-so-friendly rooster blocking your path.
subtitles.zh: （公鸡打鸣）他们什么都见过，如果你是南卡罗来纳州的这位亚马逊快递员，那还包括一只不太友好的公鸡挡住了你的去路。

subtitles.en: But fear not, all ye waiting on packages.
subtitles.zh: 不过别担心，各位等着收包裹的朋友们。

subtitles.en: He took a shortcut right over the porch railing and back to his van.
subtitles.zh: 他直接翻过门廊栏杆抄了近路，回到了货车里。

subtitles.en: We have a peek tonight at Taylor Swift’s new music video.
subtitles.zh: 今晚我们来抢先看一眼泰勒·斯威夫特的新音乐视频。

subtitles.en: "CBS Mornings" shared this exclusive first look, a clip for "Patient Zero," Taylor’s new single.
subtitles.zh: 《CBS早间新闻》独家分享了首发片段，是泰勒新单曲《Patient Zero》的一段剪辑。

subtitles.en: The song comes out tomorrow while the video with actors Dakota Johnson and Colin Farrell in it, will debut Sunday at the MTV Video Music Awards, airing right here on CBS.
subtitles.zh: 这首歌明天发行，而由演员达科塔·约翰逊和科林·法瑞尔出演的MV将在周日的MTV音乐录影带大奖上首播，颁奖礼就在CBS播出。

subtitles.en: And when we come back tonight the U.S.-China relationship beyond the pomp and the pandas.
subtitles.zh: 稍后回来，今晚我们聊聊美中关系——除了排场和熊猫之外的部分。

subtitles.en: We are back live from Washington, D.C. after a day of meetings President Trump is honoring President Xi Jinping of China with a state dinner in the East Room tonight.
subtitles.zh: 我们现在回到华盛顿特区的直播现场。经过一天的会谈，特朗普总统今晚将在东厅设国宴款待中国国家主席习近平。

subtitles.en: It includes a performance from President Trump’s favorite tenor, that’s Christopher Macchio.
subtitles.zh: 宴会还包括特朗普总统最喜欢的男高音克里斯托弗·马基奥的表演。

subtitles.en: A three-course meal, also, of yellow squash, sesame-crusted sea bass, and a honey ice cream made from the White House’s own hives.
subtitles.zh: 此外还有三道菜：黄南瓜、芝麻脆皮海鲈鱼，以及用白宫自家蜂箱产的蜂蜜做的蜂蜜冰淇淋。

subtitles.en: There will be a toast of sparkling wine meant to honor the so-called toast of peace between Richard Nixon and the Chinese premier in 1972.
subtitles.zh: 还将用起泡酒举杯，致敬1972年理查德·尼克松和中国总理之间所谓的“和平之酒”。

subtitles.en: And we learned today of another form of diplomacy that’s coming and this one’s a lot more accessible to the rest of us.
subtitles.zh: 我们今天还了解到另一种即将到来的外交形式，而这种形式对我们普通人来说更容易接触。

subtitles.en: President Xi announced a new gift of giant pandas.
subtitles.zh: 习近平主席宣布将赠送新的大熊猫。

subtitles.en: They are on their way to a zoo in Atlanta, part of what Xi called an envoy of friendship between our two nations, a gesture that dates all the way back to 1972, when First Lady Pat Nixon told the Chinese premier how much she enjoyed the pandas in Beijing.
subtitles.zh: 它们将前往亚特兰大的一家动物园，这是习主席所说两国之间“友谊使者”的一部分；这一姿态可以追溯到1972年，当时第一夫人帕特·尼克松告诉中国总理，她非常喜欢北京的熊猫。

subtitles.en: A pair of them then arrived in the U.S. the start of 50 years now of panda diplomacy.
subtitles.zh: 随后一对大熊猫抵达美国，开启了延续至今50年的熊猫外交。

subtitles.en: And yet, all the pandas in the world and a state dinner every night of the year wouldn’t be enough to hide the strain in this U.S.-China relationship.
subtitles.zh: 然而，就算全世界的大熊猫都来了，一年到头每晚都办国宴，也不足以掩盖美中关系中的紧张。

subtitles.en: Tonight, they’re going to be in the same room, but still far apart on the biggest issues facing our two countries and the world.
subtitles.zh: 今晚，他们将同处一室，但在两国和世界面临的最大问题上仍然相距甚远。

subtitles.en: That’s another day in America.
subtitles.zh: 这就是美国的又一天。

subtitles.en: I’m Tony Dokoupil here in Washington, D.C. for all of us at CBS News thank you for watching.
subtitles.zh: 我是托尼·多库皮尔，在华盛顿特区，代表CBS新闻全体同仁感谢您的收看。

subtitles.en: Good night.
subtitles.zh: 晚安。
